The three adjacent coordinate swaps and shear x0->x0+x1 generate GL4(F2), and an independent from-scratch C++ BFS on all masks generated 141 orbits with exact total 2^20−1. Geometric smoothness requires no projective common zeros of the four formal derivatives over the algebraic closure (Euler cubic relation in char2); exact Gröbner unit-ideal tests on every x_i=1 chart, not merely rational point checks, leave 36 smooth orbits of combined weight 322,560. A separately developed SymPy reimplementation of derivative evaluation and all four-chart smoothness checks independently produced the identical 36 masks and all 14 weighted Gauss partition cells. The verified partition table sums to 322,560, with max fiber3, injective164,640 and size-three cell total21,840. Orbit invariance under PGL4 transports the rational tangent-plane fiber partition to every member. Complete finite enumeration is mathematically exhaustive here, unlike partial finite probing of an infinite claim.
